svg.text: Annual Report RAG on Azure — end-to-end architecture

Compare two years (FY2025 vs FY2026) of Infosys and Eternal annual reports. Each year is searched separately, four guardrails check the question and the answer, and a person reviews any answer whose numbers cannot be traced.
① BUILD TIME · run once, then after changes
Your laptop · python … · uses the search ADMIN key
The 4 PDFs in pdfs/ → Blob Storage
config.py every setting in one file (top-k 20 → 5, thresholds)
.env keys and endpoints (never committed, never deployed)
tests/ 31 offline tests: no Azure, no cost
The web app never runs ingestion: it gets a read-only
search QUERY key and no storage key.

startup.sh → python -u UI/server.py · 1 instance · health check /health
2 · retrieve — hybrid search, once per year → 20 each
3 · rerank — semantic ranker score → keep best 5 per year
4 · generate — gpt-5.1 writes the FY2025 vs FY2026 answer
5 · output_guardrail — format · numbers in right year · claims
